blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — An environmental group has urged Marinduque Gov. Melecio Go to help facilitate the implementation of a $100-million (about P6.4 billion) settlement for the rehabilitation of areas affected by the 1996 Marcopper mining disaster. The Marinduque Council for Environmental Concerns (MACEC) on Nov. 9 urged Go to convene the Provincial Rehabilitation and Remediation Oversight Committee to fast-track a comprehensive rehabilitation master plan for the province, saying residents have waited nearly three decades for environmental justice. Rev. Fr. Arvin Anthony Madla, MACEC chairperson, said the settlement should translate into concrete benefits for communities that have endured decades of […]...
